scope: Approved current fixed-endpoint profile only; not arbitrary raw BFRT policies
conclusion: Stored master-IP comparison is redundant for current qualified paths, conditional on a stable master-IP binding invariant.

symbols: data_connection: exact IPv4/TCP four-tuple lookup, defaultNoAction
guard: kind5/6/7 normal/return admissions require enabled1; generic abort/reject returns become kind255
real_links_t: stores onlystage1kind5 and compares onlystage0kind6/7

source_references.facts: One master/outstation pair supplied per build; exactly inverse fwd4/rev4 data_connection rows.
One endpoints()/rows.build() call per install plan.
Same tuple/directions for FIRST and RETURN port connection rows.
Reconnect uses same IP pair and varies TCP port; unknown-port connection is unbound.

qualified_path_reasoning: SELECT store only after exact master->relay data_connection lookup and guard admission.
OPERATE comparison uses request ip.src from the same installed request tuple.
SELECT/OPERATE responses use reply ip.dst from the exact inverse tuple.
Both FIRST and recirculated packets repeat the same IP/TCP tuple lookup; internal header split does not alter IPv4 endpoints.
An invalid/unconfigured generic return takes kind255; no object-store/compare row matches it.
READ paths use separate read_connection and do not execute these control-object stores/comparisons.
minimum_policy_invariant_to_lock: All qualified control request bindings must use the same master IPv4 address, replies must have that address as destination, and this address must remain constant while associated N object state is retained. Current profile meets this through exactly two reciprocal four-tuple rows.
falsifier_outside_current_profile: Raw BFRT can install asymmetric/two-master rows or rebind masterIP while old N state survives. size2 alone does not guarantee reciprocity or one-master identity. A future multi-master policy must restore explicit binding state/checks or isolate state per master before using this reduction.
verification_class: Source/control-plane/driver inspection; no SDK compile, model trial, or hardware result for the proposed DL/native_start repack.
